description:
This well-presented four-bedroom detached family home comes to the market in excellent condition throughout and occupies an attractive corner site within a quiet, low-density development in Mullingar. Offering bright and spacious accommodation, mature landscaped rear garden and a detached home office, the property is within easy reach of the town centre and major road networks.

The accommodation opens with a welcoming entrance hall leading to a comfortable living room with dual-aspect windows and a solid fuel stove with marble surround. A second, particularly spacious sitting room features a recently installed solid fuel stove. The generous kitchen and dining room is fitted with an extensive range of wall and floor units, granite worktops, integrated cooking appliances and an American-style fridge/freezer. Sliding patio doors open directly onto the rear garden. A guest WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, the property offers four well-proportioned bedrooms, each benefiting from built-in wardrobes. The primary bedroom is particularly spacious, with dual-aspect windows, two sets of fitted wardrobes and a private en-suite shower room. The fully tiled family bathroom features a Jacuzzi bath with jets and a Triton electric shower.

Externally, the property enjoys a rear garden with a patio area. Two gated side entrances provide convenient access, while the generous tarmacadam driveway offers ample off-street parking. A particularly useful addition is the detached, fully insulated garden building, currently used as a home office and complete with power and fitted shelving.

The property occupies a convenient position towards the front of the development, within easy reach of Mullingar town centre, Holy Family Primary School, Millmount Shopping Centre, local shops and the Mullingar Park Hotel. The bus and train stations are also readily accessible, while the nearby Ardmore Road provides convenient access to the N4, with the N52 and wider road network also within easy reach.

Viewing is highly recommended.
